lines.say: This is a vet hard mode Tideborn Taleria kill, uploaded to E-S-O Logs.
Paste the same link into E-S-O Toolkit.

The insights page answers the usual post-pull questions: who ran Colossus, Barrier and Horn, which champion points were slotted, how long the key buffs and debuffs stayed up, and where the damage came from.
The damage and healing tables show who died, who got rezzed, and everyone's casts per minute.
The damage graph shows exactly when it went wrong: five players died within two seconds, and the group's damage stayed down for about fifty seconds.
E-S-O Logs lists a player's gear one item per row. E-S-O Toolkit groups it into sets, shows both bars the way they look in game, and flags low-quality gear and enchants.
If you'd rather see it item by item, the Info button lists every piece, just like E-S-O Logs.
It also works out which scripts a scribed skill was running, from the combat events.
E-S-O Logs replays the fight on a flat map. E-S-O Toolkit rebuilds it in 3D, so you can orbit the arena and follow any player.
To copy a build, send it straight to the Build Editor. Or start from what top players run: the Build Leaderboard groups top-ranked parses by the build behind them, for each class and boss.
The scribing planner builds a skill one script at a time, and the calculators check your penetration and crit.

For trials, the Roster Builder plans the whole group: tanks, healers and damage dealers, their sets and ultimates, and separate builds for each fight. Share it as a link, publish it to Roster Hub, or post it to Discord, where the roster bot takes sign-ups.
For addons there is Kalpa, a free addon manager. It installs and updates addons in one click, pulls in the libraries they depend on, and installs whole community packs from Pack Hub.
E-S-O Logs records the fight. E-S-O Toolkit shows you what happened, and what to fix next time. It's free, at E-S-O-T-K dot com.
